**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

- **§ 8.2** — automatic renewal in successive **twelve-month** terms (not multi-year), Customer non-renewal notice of **thirty days**, plus a **sixty-day** Vendor reminder with a deadline extension in our favour if the reminder is missed.
- **§ 8.3** — renewal uplift capped at the **lesser of CPI-U and three percent**, with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods.

Every preferred atomic element is already met on the face of the document, so mutual-written-agreement renewal is not required and no change is sought.
